_comment: Shopify stores an uploaded film as a Video media object, not a plain file, so 'name.mp4' | file_url does not resolve it. Each film's real CDN URL goes here and build_templates.py substitutes it. Find one in Content > Files: its preview image is /preview_images/<hash>..., and the film itself is https://cdn.shopify.com/videos/c/o/v/<hash>.mp4
